name: Nigeria
people: Where Nigerians and Co-designers design the nation they want to live in.
codesigner: Everyone who shares a vision, a voice or an enterprise here becomes a Co-designer of Perfect Nigeria: one of a community of selfless people, at home and abroad, building a nation where every citizen has a decent life.

portrait.alt: Nigeria in Bloom, nation portrait of Nigeria
portrait.title: Nigeria in Bloom

paras: Green, white and green: the green for your land and the white for peace, under a motto that asks for Unity and Faith, Peace and Progress. You are the most populous nation in Africa, and the world already competes to lend to you.
letter.quote: “The world lent you $2.35 billion in a single week. Now let a full table in every home be the return.”

mandates.terms: For the Government of Nigeria, its development partners and investors. Scope and fees are agreed in writing before any work begins.

capita.pc_text: The yearly cost, per person, of lifting everyone above the Living Line in all seven basic living standards, set with Nigeria in its own prices.
capita.price_text: Perfect Capita times the population: the national bill, each year.
capita.est: Perfect Nations estimate, to be confirmed with Nigeria. Figures marked dated rest on surveys more than five years old; lenient measures are marked as such.
capita.measures: Strict measures. Food: share not moderately or severely food insecure (FAO). Water: safely managed drinking water where measured; where it is not, basic water, marked as such. Shelter: the lower of safely managed sanitation and the share outside urban slums. Energy: the lower of electricity per person against 1,000 kWh and clean cooking. Education: the lower of children reading by the end of primary school and lower-secondary completion. Health: WHO service coverage index. Livelihood: share above the stricter of the national poverty line and the World Bank line for the nation’s income group. Each figure links to its source.

voices.local: We are looking for the people with real stories from Nigeria: the leaders who built something that works, and the keepers of local knowledge who know how their communities live, cope and thrive.

close_lead: Share your vision, suggest a guest, or write to us. Every message receives a personal reply.
sources: World Bank, World Development Indicators: population 2025, urban share, agricultural and forest land, renewable fresh water per person and renewable energy share, read 30 October 2026.

Strict Perfect Capita inputs: FAO food insecurity, WHO/UNICEF water and sanitation, World Bank clean cooking, learning poverty and poverty lines, UNESCO completion and the WHO service coverage index (2023, via Our World in Data).
International Monetary Fund and World Bank press releases for each register line, as linked.
